units: pixels and seconds; image coordinates x right, y down, origin top-left
summary: Static side view of a light-grey gym wall with a black baseboard and wooden floor. A woman (beige cap, white tank top, olive cargo pants) stands at the far left holding a basketball, dips it (wind-up) and tosses it up and to the right; the ball flies in a parabola across the frame, bounces on the floor at x~1354 (frame 114), bounces a second time near the right edge (frame 145) and leaves the frame on the right (last partial view frame 148). The woman then walks to the right from about frame 118 to the end (still walking at frame 169).
